caseName: In re 18.86 Acres of Real Property
caseNameFull: In re 18.86 Acres of Real Property

opinions.text:
Appeal from Super. Ct. N. J., App. Div., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
